quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for an impossibly smooth vibration whose regularity excludes conventional engines.
quests.explanation: Impossibly smooth freight vibration distinguishes maglev in a cyber city from all wheeled transport.
quests.textToSpeak: The cyber district's maglev freight moves with a vibration too smooth to come from wheels.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a sustained wind note held for seconds at a single pitch in a dense wooded pass.
quests.explanation: A sustained single-pitch wind note held in a wooded pass identifies a mountain forest.
quests.textToSpeak: Mountain forest passes funnel the wind into a note that sustains for several seconds.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for ordinary ship sounds that have an uncanny lightness from the absence of gravity.
quests.explanation: Ordinary sounds with uncanny lightness identify a spacecraft in free-fall outer space.
quests.textToSpeak: The ship in free fall makes the familiar sounds of home feel subtly wrong.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a sound at the edge of perception from precision molecular-scale equipment.
quests.explanation: Near-inaudible molecular printing at the threshold of perception identifies an advanced laboratory.
quests.textToSpeak: The molecular printer operates at the threshold of human hearing, its work invisible.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for military commands that carry across open ground in the half-light before dawn.
quests.explanation: Military commands carrying across a parade ground at first light identify a military base.
quests.textToSpeak: Pre-dawn commands carry across the base as the first grey light touches the parade ground.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for instruments registering both heat signature and the subtle sound of organism movement.
quests.explanation: Instrument-registered vent heat and organism movement sounds identify the deep ocean floor.
quests.textToSpeak: The deep volcanic vent's heat creates a shimmer that the submersible instruments can detect.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for regular, clockwork-timed vibrations in an underground space from surface transit.
quests.explanation: Clockwork transit vibrations in an underground space identify a vault under a transit line.
quests.textToSpeak: The transit above sends vibrations down into the vault with clockwork regularity.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the paradox of seeing visible motion while hearing only station background hum.
quests.explanation: Visible motion in heard silence identifies an orbital station observation perspective.
quests.textToSpeak: In station silence, the Earth below completes its eternal revolution without sound.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a resonance that seems older than the current stones, as if absorbed over centuries.
quests.explanation: Ancient absorbed resonance in walls identifies a continuously active ancient temple.
quests.textToSpeak: The temple's walls have been resonating since before living memory; the echo knows it.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for refrigeration hum as a continuous layer beneath PA audio in a departure area.
quests.explanation: Continuous refrigeration under PA audio layers identifies an airport departure area.
quests.textToSpeak: Refrigerated duty-free cabinets layer their hum under the PA announcements continuously.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for an echo that adds a warm resonance no modern material could produce.
quests.explanation: A warm historic echo in a transit hall identifies a historical train station.
quests.textToSpeak: A historical station's echo carries the memory of steam engines in every sound.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a silence whose quality has been formed by decades of careful human behaviour.
quests.explanation: Behaviour-formed silence identifies a well-used scholarly archive in a public library.
quests.textToSpeak: An archive's silence has been shaped by generations of respectful scholarly attention.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a sudden shift from retail ambient noise to focused audience attention sounds.
quests.explanation: A shift from retail noise to audience focus identifies a shopping mall flash mob event.
quests.textToSpeak: A flash mob begins in the central atrium; the crowd shifts from shopping to audience.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the precise timing of service sounds as a composed, repeating pattern.
quests.explanation: Precisely timed service sounds forming a pattern identify a luxury restaurant at its peak.
quests.textToSpeak: Service at this level is so precise that the sounds of the evening form a kind of music.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the temporal shift from bird-dominated to human-dominated sound across a park morning.
quests.explanation: A temporal shift from birds to human activity identifies a city park morning progression.
quests.textToSpeak: A park morning shifts from birdsong to footsteps to children's voices across the hours.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for an MRI's rhythmic pattern penetrating through hospital walls from an adjacent room.
quests.explanation: MRI rhythm through walls identifies a hospital diagnostic imaging wing.
quests.textToSpeak: An MRI sequence fills the wing with its precise rhythmic pattern through the walls.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a ground sensation that precedes the airborne sound by a fraction of a second.
quests.explanation: Felt-before-heard impact rhythm identifies a construction site pile driver.
quests.textToSpeak: The pile driver's rhythm is felt through the floor before it is heard through the air.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a unique combination of harvest machine, bee, and human sounds found only briefly.
quests.explanation: The unique seasonal complexity of harvest sounds identifies a lush farm in harvest season.
quests.textToSpeak: Harvest time fills the farm with a sound complexity that only exists a few weeks a year.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a sudden collective reorientation of a crowd toward incoming water sound.
quests.explanation: A crowd turning toward approaching water identifies a sandy beach receiving a large surf set.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the layering of mist movement, animal breath, and minimal forest activity in a hush.

quests.textToSpeak: Mist, animal breath, and the soft sounds of undisturbed forest life create a layered hush.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for measurement instrument sounds registering an impossible bending of detected light.
quests.explanation: Instruments registering impossible light-bending identify a spacecraft near a black hole.
quests.textToSpeak: Instruments measure the gravitational lensing of a black hole bending starlight.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a combined high-voltage hum, ozone crackle, and electronic system response at full power.
quests.explanation: A full-power particle accelerator sound environment identifies a high-energy physics laboratory.
quests.textToSpeak: The particle accelerator at full power creates a sound environment unlike any other.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.

quests.textToSpeak: The night patrol's radio check comes so reliably that absence would be the emergency.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a sonar return so anomalously large that the instrument briefly hesitates.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a silence old enough to have its own distinct acoustic character.
quests.explanation: Aged-sealed silence with its own character identifies an underground vault.
quests.textToSpeak: The vault contains a silence that was sealed before most living people were born.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.

quests.explanation: A structure-resonant hum identifies an orbital station's harmonic operational frequency.
quests.textToSpeak: Station systems maintain their hum at a frequency that resonates with the structure itself.

quests.explanation: A fire synchronized with priestly breath identifies an ancient temple inner sanctum ceremony.

quests.hint: Listen for a directional quality in the ambient airport noise that indicates organized movement.
quests.explanation: Directional ambient noise indicating organized movement identifies an airport terminal.
